title: Classified SCIF testimony to Congress
summary: Jake Barber tells of Classified SCIF testimony to Congress, about before 2025 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I'm telling you um and more has been shared with Congress in a in a in a skiff in a top secret uh TSCI

plain: Jake Barber, a former military helicopter pilot who says he flew to recover a UFO, says that more than he can say publicly has been shared with members of Congress in a SCIF, a sealed room where secret material can be discussed. He says it was given at the top secret level, under the highest security clearance (TS/SCI), which if true would mean lawmakers have heard detailed evidence behind closed doors.
